def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("white car")
    if not car_patches: return image_patch
    
    # Find the center of the image
    img_width, img_height = image.shape[1], image.shape[0]
    center_x, center_y = img_width / 2, img_height / 2
    
    # Sort cars based on their distance from the center
    car_patches.sort(key=lambda p: abs(p.horizontal_center - center_x))
    
    # Select the car closest to the center
    central_car = car_patches[0]
    
    # Check if the car is in the central parking lot
    if central_car.left < center_x < central_car.right and central_car.lower < center_y < central_car.upper:
        return central_car
    else:
        return []
